facts.fact_text: The "TRNC" regime refused to register an association called the "Kutlu Adalı Foundation", whose aims include the furthering of the ideas of Kutlu Adalı regarding peace, democracy, human rights and freedom.

On 20 June 1997 the public authorities prevented the applicant and her daughter from attending a meeting organised by a radio station in southern Cyprus, by not giving them permission to cross over to the southern part of Cyprus.
On the anniversary of Kutlu Adalı's death the applicant organised a ceremony to commemorate her husband.
On the day of the commemoration ceremony for Kutlu Adalı, the municipality brought in digging machines to dig up the road just under the applicant's street.
The application to establish the Adalı Foundation, which sixty democratic organisations wanted to set up in order to continue Kutlu Adalı's work, was initially refused.
The registration fee for the Adalı Foundation was increased fivefold and the applicant sold a plot of land to raise the money.
The charter of the Adalı Foundation had to be changed; for example, the phrase "democratic activities" was replaced by "cultural activities".
